metadata.title: नागा कस्टमरी लॉ और औरतों की दावेदारी | The Adivasi Question | Naga Customary Laws
metadata.description:
The tribes of Nagaland follow their own, strict customary laws, under which the women are largely considered secondary to men. The women have very little representation in politics, both at the state and local body level. That is why when on January 29, 2021 Khrienuo Metha was elected the first woman tribal chief in the state, it was touted as a big victory for women's rights.

Anchor: Smitha Nair
